content.short: Socketccan is a Web3 privacy infrastructure for tracking cross-chain bridge transactions.
content.description: Socketccan, launched by Bungee, is a Web3 privacy infrastructure designed for social interactions around crypto. It enables users to track bridge activity across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Avalanche, Gnosis Chain, Fantom, Optimism, Arbitrum and Aurora, giving a broad view of cross-chain transfers while maintaining privacy. Developers can view the latest transactions on the site and use the information to support their dapps as they build on multiple chains.
content.meta: Socketccan provides Web3 privacy infrastructure for social interactions in crypto. Discover Socketccan and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
